title: Tall white deep spacecraft schedules and the five-year run from the home planet

tellings.quote: The longest schedule I saw was craft that take five years. And those craft with a fiveyear schedule, I was told, were coming directly from their home planet.

plain: Tall, pale beings that Charles Hall calls the Tall Whites kept flight schedules for their deep-space craft, and the longest he saw was five years, for craft he was told came straight from their home planet. Hall, a man who says he spent three years around these beings in the mid-1960s in Indian Springs Valley, Nevada, near Area 51, tells Michels this from what he saw and what he says he was told. If true, it would mean regular traffic between Earth and another world.
